verdict.rationale: DeepInfra publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec with 132 paths. It spans serverless inference, custom model deployments and GPU rentals, and has a hosted Swagger try-it-out explorer, so its documented API surface goes well beyond chat completions. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that everything doable in the web UI (e.g. account, billing, key management) is also exposed via the API; the 404s on deepinfra.com probe paths reflect only alternate locations, not a missing spec. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, evidence of API coverage for account, billing and key management, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The DeepInfra API provides serverless AI inference, custom model deployments, and GPU rentals
a vendor-hosted interactive explorer with runnable try-it-out requests against the live API
